verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is designed for single-URL-to-text conversion via r.jina.ai, with proxy rotation, caching, and anti-bot handling that support reliability at scale, but there is no explicit batch/async endpoint, job queue, or bulk-submission API for thousands of URLs — engineers would need to build their own concurrency/orchestration layer on top of single-URL calls. Community evidence also flags auth/rate-limit uncertainty for heavy use.
